sourceData.meaningMnemonic: One way to put <radical>wheat</radical> in your <radical>face</radical> is with <kanji>noodles</kanji>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: Once you're done stuffing noodles in your face, you can use your leftover noodles to make <kanji>noodle</kanji><reading>men</reading> (<ja>めん</ja>).
sourceData.meaningInfo: Imagine yourself shoveling piles of wheaty noodles into your face. They're so wheaty and delicious!
sourceData.readingInfo: Did you ever use to make pictures with your food? (Or maybe you still do? We won't judge.) Imagine you're doing that again, and think about how lifelike your noodle men are!
